_readme: Scores NEA's first-party stage label (sources/site/company-list.json stage_site) against the documented round in which NEA first invested. Sample: 25 Seed, 25 Growth, 15 Early rows, stratified 1997-2025, tech and healthcare, chosen for documentability (so skewed toward well-covered companies). Taxonomy: Pre-Seed | Seed | Series A | Growth (Series B and later). agrees is null for Early (a bucket, not a round) and for unresolved rows. Citations are SEC S-1/DRS/S-4 filings, TechCrunch/press releases, or Google News headlines; notes flag weak ties (round or NEA only via full-text match, or entry dated by fund vintage / board date). Built 2026-09-30 by a scoring subagent; Google News items also logged in scratch/news-extra-score.json.

rows.name: TiVo
rows.label: Seed
rows.note: S-1 (1999) related-party table: entities affiliated with NEA bought 2,000,000 Series A (co-equal with IVP). First institutional round, seed-sized by today's standard but named Series A.

rows.label: Seed
